hero_kpi_rationale: Net Interest Income is the primary revenue driver for First Commonwealth, reflecting its traditional banking strategy focused on lending and deposits.

kpis.name: Net Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest earned on assets and interest paid on liabilities.
kpis.description: Indicates the core profitability of the bank's lending and deposit activities. Metric tracked annually by company analysts, with historical data over the past 5 years.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in core banking operations.

kpis.name: Provision for Credit Losses
kpis.explanation: Amount set aside to cover expected loan losses.
kpis.description: Measures anticipation of payment defaults and potential impact on earnings.
kpis.signal: Increase in provisions reflecting heightened caution amid economic risks.

kpis.name: Total Shareholder Return

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Interest rate risk is identified as a key factor affecting the company's revenues and cash flows. Changes in interest rates can have a significant impact on financial results.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: Credit risk relates to the company's loans and investments. Payment defaults or loan losses can negatively impact financial performance.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: Liquidity risk pertains to the company's ability to meet its payment obligations. Liquidity difficulties can negatively affect financial results.

risks.title: Operational Risk
risks.score_rationale: Operational risk stems from human error, system failures, and other operational issues. These risks can negatively impact financial performance.

risks.title: Reputational Risk
risks.score_rationale: Reputational risk relates to client and investor confidence in the company. Reputational issues can negatively impact financial results.

risks.title: Technology Risk
risks.score_rationale: Technology risk relates to the adoption of new technologies and the company's ability to integrate them effectively. Technological failures can negatively impact financial results.

risks.title: Goodwill Risk
risks.score_rationale: Goodwill risk relates to the value of the company's intangible assets. Impairment of these assets can negatively impact financial results.
